title: Check if a program is installed and where it is
summary: Before you run a program in the terminal, ask the shell whether it exists and where it is stored. These commands only read information and change nothing.

aliases.text: как проверить есть ли программа в системе

steps.explain: Ask the shell whether the program exists. If a path is printed, the program is installed and the path is where it is stored. If nothing is printed, the program is not installed or is not in your PATH.

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: Name of the program to check, without a path

steps.expect: A path such as /usr/bin/git. If the program is missing, nothing is printed and the exit status is 1.

steps.explain: List every place where the name is found, in the order the shell searches for it. type -a also shows aliases and shell built-ins.

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: Name of the program to check, without a path

steps.expect: One line per location, for example 'git is /usr/bin/git'. If the name is missing, the output says 'not found'.

alternatives.explain: The same list with the which tool. which is not installed on every minimal system, for example a fresh Fedora container. If you see 'which: command not found', use type -a instead.

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: Name of the program to check, without a path

alternatives.expect: One path per line. If the program is missing, nothing is printed.

verify.expect: Nothing is printed and the exit status is 1

source.title: bash manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
